contributions.title: Property valuation & housing risk
contributions.description: Built machine-learning models for residential property valuation and compared model-implied housing risk across Maltese localities.
contributions.approach: Used property modelling to examine geographical differences in estimated valuations and model-implied risk, keeping the locality dimension visible in the analysis.
contributions.output: Locality-level valuation and risk comparisons, providing a basis for interpreting housing-market differences across Malta.

contributions.title: Population forecasting & housing demand
contributions.description: Developed locality-level population forecasts and connected demographic trajectories to possible changes in housing demand and valuations.
contributions.approach: Examined alternative population trajectories by locality and considered how differences in demographic change could feed into housing-demand and valuation scenarios.
contributions.output: A link between demographic forecasts and housing scenarios, allowing population assumptions to be considered alongside property-market analysis.

contributions.title: Retail banking pricing
contributions.description: Benchmarked competitors’ retail fees and charging structures, translating the comparison into pricing-strategy recommendations.
contributions.approach: Compared subscription models, low-activity charges and alternative approaches to monetising banking usage.
contributions.output: A comparative assessment of charging structures and pricing-strategy recommendations informed by competitor benchmarking.

projects.name: S&P 500 Market Sensitivity
projects.description: Studied variation in S&P 500 companies’ market betas through regression and statistical model selection.
projects.detail: Used regression to investigate variation in companies’ market betas. Compared model specifications with the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), balancing fit against complexity, and used analysis of variance (ANOVA) to examine explanatory relationships.
projects.context: Market beta describes sensitivity to broad market movements. The project connected this financial concept to statistical inference and the choice of an appropriate explanatory model.

projects.name: Ames Housing
projects.description: Modelled house prices through data preparation, feature engineering and comparison of regression models.
projects.detail: Prepared the Ames Housing data, engineered features and compared regression approaches, including XGBoost. The work treated prediction as a complete modelling workflow, from the representation of housing characteristics to the comparison of candidate models.
projects.context: The project examined house-price prediction through systematic data preparation, feature engineering and model evaluation.

projects.name: Single-Cell Hypoxia Classification
projects.description: Studied the classification of cancer cells under hypoxic and normoxic conditions using gene-expression data.
projects.detail: Used gene-expression features to study the classification of cancer cells under hypoxic and normoxic conditions. Examined predictions alongside hypoxia-signature scores to assess whether the classifications were biologically consistent.
projects.context: The project connected a supervised-learning task with a biological check on model predictions, extending statistical learning beyond financial and housing data.
